$comment: Cover-sheet spec only. The component inventory — ids, groups and captions — lives next to the @Previews as @CatalogGroup / @CatalogComponent annotations under foundation-catalog/src/main/kotlin/ee/schimke/foundationcatalog/sections/, and the per-component BUILDER policy lives beside them as @BuilderComponent, which is what makes this a builder catalog rather than a sticker sheet. `compose-foundation` is the UI builder's own vocabulary — the containers, the screen frames and the image asset a design is assembled out of — published so `m3-catalog` and `wear-m3-catalog` can borrow them from a delivery branch instead of from Kotlin synthesised inside the preview server. There is no `referenceKits` and no `compareWith`: this catalog reproduces no Figma kit and is paired with nothing, which is why every component declares `noReference` with its reason. See docs/design/FOUNDATION_CATALOG.md.
title: Compose Foundation
